metadata.document_title: LESCO Residential Electricity Tariffs, Billing Rules, Prosumer Net-Billing & Metering Configuration Schema

amendments.effect: Restores 1:1 unit netting and Rs 25.32/kWh (NAPPP) buyback rate for valid net-metering agreements executed before 2026-02-09 until expiry of their 7-year contract term.

amendments.sro: S.R.O. 1330(I)/2026 (also cited in press as S.R.O. 1320(I)/2026)
amendments.effect: Exempts distributed generation facilities <= 25 kW from seeking NEPRA concurrence (saving Rs 1,000/kW fee).

lifeline.definition: Single-phase Non-ToU residential consumer with sanctioned load <= 1 kW whose maximum monthly consumption across the last 12 months and current billing month is <= 100 kWh.
lifeline.transition_rule: Exceeding 100 kWh in any single month disqualifies the consumer from Lifeline status for the next 12 months.
lifeline.fixed_charge_rule: Nil (Rs 0/month). Minimum monthly customer charge of Rs 75/consumer/month (single-phase) applies only when zero monthly energy/fixed charges are billed.

protected.definition: Non-ToU residential consumer (< 5 kW) consuming <= 200 kWh per month consistently for the past 6 consecutive months.
protected.slab_application_formula: If consumption <= 100 kWh: all units @ Rs 10.54/kWh + Rs 200/kW/month fixed charge. If consumption is 101-200 kWh: first 100 units @ Rs 10.54/kWh + (units - 100) @ Rs 13.01/kWh + Rs 300/kW/month fixed charge.
protected.transition_rule: Consuming >= 201 kWh in any single month (after pro-rata normalization if reading cycle > calendar month days) moves the consumer immediately to Unprotected for that month and breaks the 6-month consistency requirement for the next 6 consecutive months.

unprotected.definition: All Non-ToU residential consumers (< 5 kW) who do not qualify as Lifeline or Protected.
unprotected.slab_application_formula: Every unit from unit 1 to total monthly kWh is billed at the single variable rate of the highest slab reached in that billing month.

topic_B_time_of_use_residential_tariff_A.mandatory_threshold: Sanctioned load >= 5 kW (3-Phase 400V connection and ToU/AMI meter mandatory)
topic_B_time_of_use_residential_tariff_A.optional_eligibility: Residential consumers with sanctioned load < 5 kW may opt for ToU metering and be billed under A-1(b)
topic_B_time_of_use_residential_tariff_A.billing_demand_discrepancy_note: Primary NEPRA Annex-V Part-I Clause 4 defines Billing Demand as max(25% of sanctioned load, actual monthly MDI). Secondary portals (eBillPakistan, BijliBills) cite max(50% of sanctioned load, actual MDI) or full integer sanctioned load kW.
topic_B_time_of_use_residential_tariff_A.statutory_clause: Part-I, Clause 10 of Annex-V, NEPRA LESCO Rebasing Decision dated 07-01-2026 (Page 21)

fuel_price_adjustment_fpa.basis: Billed on units consumed 2 months prior (e.g., Oct 2026 bill charges Aug 2026 FCA on Aug 2026 kWh)

quarterly_tariff_adjustment_qta.basis: Billed on current month imported kWh

electricity_duty_ed.statutory_announcement: Discontinued via electricity bills effective 2025-07-01 per Federal/Punjab directive
electricity_duty_ed.empirical_2026_bill_discrepancy: 1.5% of (Variable Energy + QTA + FPA) continues to appear on many actual 2026 LESCO bills; EMS software should provide a boolean toggle (0% vs 1.5%).

general_sales_tax_gst.taxable_base: Variable Energy + Fixed Charges + QTA + FC Surcharge + Electricity Duty + Meter Rent, plus 18% on (FPA + ED on FPA)

new_prosumers_on_or_after_2026_02_09.import_billing_rate: Full applicable consumer-end tariff (Peak/Off-Peak) + FC Surcharge + QTA + FCA + 18% GST
new_prosumers_on_or_after_2026_02_09.export_buyback_rate_basis: National Average Energy Purchase Price (NAEPP) determined in CPPA-G PPP Decision dated 07-01-2026 (Para 36) and confirmed in S.R.O. 1501(I)/2026 (Para 23)
new_prosumers_on_or_after_2026_02_09.discrepancy_explanation: Feb 2026 news reports cited ~Rs 10-11/kWh (or Rs 11.30/kWh) based on older FY25 pool figures, and consumer-end loss-adjusted energy component is Rs 9.12/kWh, but statutory NAEPP is Rs 8.13/kWh.
new_prosumers_on_or_after_2026_02_09.settlement_rule: Net rupee credit rolls over to next monthly bill or is paid quarterly (Reg. 14(2)).

grandfathered_prosumers_before_2026_02_0.export_buyback_rate_basis: National Average Power Purchase Price (NAPPP) for CY 2026 (confirmed in S.R.O. 1501(I)/2026 Para 23)
grandfathered_prosumers_before_2026_02_0.renewal_or_modification_rule: Upon expiry of the 7-year term (Reg. 21(3)) or if any substantive modification alters maximum electrical output (Reg. 21(2) proviso), the prosumer transitions to the 5-year Net-Billing regime at NAEPP (Rs 8.13/kWh).

technical_and_eligibility_limits.eligible_phases: Three-Phase (400V or 11kV) only (Reg. 2(1)(v)). Single-phase (<5 kW) connections must upgrade to 3-phase to qualify.
technical_and_eligibility_limits.max_system_size_relative_to_sanctioned_l: 100% of Sanctioned Load (1.0x cap under Reg. 3(2); reduced from 1.5x in 2015 rules)
technical_and_eligibility_limits.distribution_transformer_hosting_cap: 80% of transformer rated capacity (Reg. 3(5) second proviso)
technical_and_eligibility_limits.nepra_concurrence_exemption_threshold: <= 25 kW exempted from NEPRA concurrence and Rs 1,000/kW fee effective 2026-08-06 via S.R.O. 1330(I)/2026

topic_E_meter_types_in_lahore.green_meter_definition: Colloquial and LESCO administrative term for a 3-phase four-quadrant bidirectional static digital meter installed for solar net metering up to August 2025. Halted in September 2025 in favor of 3-phase bidirectional AMI smart meters.

smart_meter_rollout_stats.source_date: 2026-08-25 (Ministry of Energy reply to Senate of Pakistan)
smart_meter_rollout_stats.percentage_share_by_meter_type: UNVERIFIED (no official census breakdown published by LESCO)

meter_requirements.tou_billing: Three-phase static ToU digital meter or three-phase AMI smart meter (mandatory >= 5 kW)
meter_requirements.net_metering_or_net_billing: Three-phase bidirectional AMI smart meter (mandatory for new prosumers since Sep 2025; legacy prosumers use 3-phase bidirectional green meter; Reg. 12(1) also permits two separate unidirectional meters)

topic_F_12_month_change_and_risk_check.details: LESCO filed CY 2027 petition (Sep 2026) seeking Rs 79,274M net distribution margin + Rs 32,782M PYA = Rs 31.71/kWh avg cost-of-service rate. Nationally DISCOs claim Rs 268B PYA; CPPA-G projects CY 2027 PPP at Rs 27.309/kWh.
CPPA-G requested +Rs 2.5624/kWh for Sep 2026 FCA (hearing on 2026-10-29).

topic_F_12_month_change_and_risk_check.item: IMF-Backed BISP Direct Cash Subsidy Replacement
topic_F_12_month_change_and_risk_check.details: Federal Govt plans to replace blanket tariff subsidies for Protected (<=200-unit) consumers with direct BISP cash disbursements (National Electricity Plan Strategic Directive 067).

topic_F_12_month_change_and_risk_check.item: Power Division Proposal to Relax 6-Month Protected Rule
topic_F_12_month_change_and_risk_check.details: Proposed limiting the Unprotected penalty for exceeding 200 units to the single month exceeded rather than 6 consecutive months; not yet notified.

topic_F_12_month_change_and_risk_check.item: Pending NEPRA Review Motion on Fixed Charges & High Court Petitions on Prosumer Regs
topic_F_12_month_change_and_risk_check.details: March 2026 review motion against Rs 200-675/kW/month residential fixed charges; LHC (Feb 2026) and IHC (Apr 2026) writ petitions challenging Net Billing and Rs 8.13/kWh buyback rate.
